title: The City Library
text:
The central library in the city has become a popular meeting place for students and families. It offers free access to thousands of books, along with computers and quiet study rooms. Many visitors come after school to prepare for their exams.

Recently, the library introduced a program that lets people borrow tools, musical instruments and board games. The director explained that the program aims to encourage creativity and to make the library useful for everyone. Although some residents were skeptical at first, many have since become regular users.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what can visitors use free of charge at the library?
According to the second paragraph, what can people borrow through the new program?
options: Tools, musical instruments and board games

questions.text: What can be inferred about the library's new program?
options: It is intended to make the library more useful to the community
It was created mainly to earn money from rentals
It was rejected by all residents
It only serves visitors over sixty

questions.text: What can be concluded about the residents who were skeptical at first?
options: Their opinion of the program changed over time
They refused to visit the library ever again
They had never heard of the library

paragraph_translations: Şehrin merkez kütüphanesi, öğrenciler ve aileler için popüler bir buluşma noktası haline geldi. Binlerce kitaba ücretsiz erişim sağlıyor; ayrıca bilgisayarlar ve sessiz çalışma odaları sunuyor. Birçok ziyaretçi, sınavlarına hazırlanmak için okuldan sonra geliyor.

Son zamanlarda kütüphane, insanların alet, müzik aletleri ve masa oyunlarını ödünç alabileceği bir program başlattı. Müdür, programın yaratıcılığı teşvik etmeyi ve kütüphaneyi herkes için yararlı kılmayı amaçladığını açıkladı. Bazı sakinler başta şüpheci olsa da, birçoğu şimdi düzenli kullanıcı haline geldi.
